owner.mass_invariant: Outside explicit per-node WRTMIN floor activation, sum(root_biomass_by_node) must equal the accepted crop root-biomass total implied by WRT_OLD+GRRT-DRRT. WRTMIN may intentionally lift a node above the proportional-death result and therefore must be diagnosed separately rather than silently renormalized.

semantics: FGWRT mixes biomass-proportional and accepted-uptake-proportional allocation of old-zone root growth
FDWRT mixes biomass-proportional and positive-stress-reduction-proportional root death
new root-zone extension receives source deepest-node biomass-density allocation capped by GRRT
WRTMIN applies as per-node rooted-thickness biomass floor after death
CUMDENS is reconstructed from accepted per-node biomass rather than persisted separately
production_reachability: adaptive profile derives shared crop_root_uptake_input_t and is consumed by the existing Reference ET/root-uptake composition; no second water sink
restart: transaction clone carries the sole accepted biomass vector; derived profile/LRV are reconstructed
claim_ceiling: Does not include SWLRVCONSTANT override, SWRD2 supply limitation, anaerobic-growth gating, or Bartholomeus/reproduction oxygen physics.

exact_matches: FGWRT old-zone growth mixture and QROTRTZ denominator
FDWRT death mixture with denominator WRT_OLD+GRRT_OLDNOD
new-zone extension fraction and GRRT_NEWNOD distribution
CUMDENS normalization from accepted WROOT_NODE inventory

remaining: Run owner and production Reference ET/root-uptake runtime gates at O0/O2.
Persist integrated qualification and verify retry/restart with accepted daily redistribution forcing.
Preserve WRTMIN floor as source effect; never silently renormalize node inventory.

reconciliation.basis: fresh branch from current integration/f-ci-canonical after CO2 admission
